title: Smart Agriculture Dashboard (React UI with IC Internet Identity, history, and visual analytics)

requirements.summary: Create a clean dashboard UI with separate pages for Crop Yield Prediction, Plant Disease Detection, Smart Irrigation Recommendation, and Data Visualizations, with persistent navigation and standard UI states.
acceptanceCriteria: App has a persistent navigation (sidebar or top nav) linking to Dashboard, Crop Yield, Disease Detection, Irrigation, Visualizations.
Each module page contains an input form, a submit action, a results panel, and clear empty/loading/error states.
All user-facing text is in English.

file_operations.description: Create the top-level app component that sets up routing and wraps pages in a persistent layout (navigation + content).
Define application routes for Dashboard, Crop Yield, Disease Detection, Irrigation, and Visualizations pages, and export route constants for use in navigation.
Implement the persistent layout (sidebar/top nav) and shared page container styling used across all pages.
Create the persistent navigation component that links to Dashboard, Crop Yield, Disease Detection, Irrigation, and Visualizations.
Create the dashboard landing page with summary cards and a hero section that references the generated illustration at frontend/public/assets/generated/dashboard-hero.dim_1600x600.png.
Create the Crop Yield Prediction page with input form, submit, results panel, and empty/loading/error states.
Create the Plant Disease Detection page with image upload, submit, results panel, and empty/loading/error states.
Create the Smart Irrigation Recommendation page with input form, submit, results panel, and empty/loading/error states.
Create the Visualizations page shell to render charts that summarize results across modules.
Add the generated minimal farm-themed logo asset and reference it from the layout/navigation branding.
Add the generated wide dashboard hero illustration asset and reference it on the Dashboard page.

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive, distinctive non-blue/non-purple visual theme across layout, forms, cards, and charts.
acceptanceCriteria: Theme is applied consistently across layout, buttons, inputs, charts, and cards.
Primary colors are not blue/purple.

file_operations.description: Create global Tailwind + CSS variable theme tokens (shadcn-compatible) using an earthy/green primary palette (not blue/purple) and consistent typography/spacing.
Adjust Tailwind theme extensions as needed to align with the new non-blue/non-purple primary palette via CSS variables (keeping existing structure).
Create a shared card wrapper component for consistent padding/borders/shadows used across module pages.
Create a shared form field component (label, input/select, inline validation message) to ensure consistent form styling across pages.
Create a consistent chart container (title, description, empty state) so charts match the global theme.

requirements.summary: Implement the Crop Yield Prediction end-to-end UI: validated inputs, backend call, results display, and at least one chart using an in-repo sample dataset for visualization context.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend form validates numeric ranges (no negative rainfall/humidity, etc.) and shows inline errors.
Calling the backend returns a numeric predicted yield and a numeric accuracy score.
Frontend renders a chart (e.g., bar/line) showing the prediction in context (e.g., feature contributions, or comparison to sample baseline values).
A sample agriculture dataset is included in the repo as a static file and referenced in code (for demo/visualization).

file_operations.description: Implement validated form controls for soilType/rainfall/temperature/humidity/fertilizerUsage, call backend predictYield, and render results with empty/loading/error states.
Add a React Query mutation hook that calls actor.predictYield and normalizes loading/duplicate-submit prevention and typed error handling.
Implement a small frontend chart component (charting library within the app code) for showing prediction vs baseline values in a themed bar chart.
Add a small static sample dataset asset for crop yield demo/visualization; load it from the frontend without external network calls.
Implement a small loader that reads frontend/public/assets/data/sample-crop-yield-dataset.json and provides baseline values for chart context.

requirements.summary: Implement Plant Disease Detection UI: leaf image upload with preview, backend submission using blob-storage ExternalBlob, and results display with clear validation/errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend supports uploading common image formats (at least PNG/JPG) and shows a preview before submission.
Backend accepts the uploaded image payload (or its encoded representation) with size/type validation and returns a structured result containing diseaseName, confidence, and treatment.
Frontend displays the result in a clear card layout and records the result into the user’s history.
If input is invalid (missing image/too large/unsupported type), user sees a clear error message.

file_operations.description: Implement image file selection (PNG/JPG), preview, size/type validation, submit action, and results card rendering.
Create a mutation hook that converts the selected file to bytes and uses the blob-storage ExternalBlob to call actor.detectDisease. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a reusable image upload component with validation and preview, used by the Disease Detection module.
Add a helper to convert browser File objects to Uint8Array for ExternalBlob.fromBytes.
Add a small in-repo disease label → suggested treatment mapping asset for demo/help text; load without external network calls.

requirements.summary: Implement Smart Irrigation Recommendation UI: validated inputs, backend call, and results display.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend validates inputs and shows error states for missing/invalid values.
Backend returns a numeric waterRequiredLitersPerAcre and a boolean/enum recommendation.
Result is shown on the page and stored in per-user history.

file_operations.description: Implement validated inputs (soilMoistureLevel/weatherCondition/temperature), call backend getIrrigationRecommendation, and display water required + recommendation with empty/loading/error states.
Add a React Query mutation hook for actor.getIrrigationRecommendation with duplicate-submit prevention and consistent error mapping.

requirements.summary: Build a Visualizations page that charts real stored history: crop yield accuracy, disease confidence distribution, and irrigation Yes/No breakdown.
acceptanceCriteria: Visualizations page shows at least: (1) crop yield accuracy score trend or distribution, (2) disease detection confidence distribution, (3) irrigation recommendation breakdown (Yes/No) over history.
Charts render from real stored history returned by the backend (not hardcoded).

file_operations.description: Load authenticated user history for all modules and render the required comparison charts with themed empty/loading/error states.
Create React Query hooks for actor.getCropYieldHistory, actor.getPlantDiseaseHistory, and actor.getIrrigationHistory, enabled only when authenticated.
Add a chart component for showing crop yield accuracy trend/distribution using the app's chart components.
Add a histogram/distribution chart component for disease confidence percentages.
Add a breakdown chart component to show irrigation recommendation Yes/No counts from history.

requirements.summary: Integrate Internet Identity sign-in/out and gate history/persistence features behind authenticated principals.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can sign in/out with Internet Identity.
When signed out, module pages still render but any “Save to history / View history” features prompt sign-in (or history is hidden).
Backend associates stored results with caller principal.

file_operations.description: Implement a login/logout button using the existing Internet Identity hook patterns and clear cached queries on logout. Use the authorization component's frontend guidance for login/logout behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a small wrapper component to conditionally render gated history sections (show sign-in prompt when signed out). Use the authorization component's gating guidance. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire LoginButton into the persistent navigation/layout and display the logged-in user name when available per the authorization component UX guidance. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add hooks to load the caller profile and prompt for profile setup on first login per the authorization component requirements. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a modal to ask for a human-readable name on first login and save it via the backend profile functions per the authorization component instructions. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add consistent client-side validation and unified UI error handling with duplicate-submission prevention while loading.
acceptanceCriteria: All backend endpoints return typed error responses for invalid payloads and unexpected failures.
Frontend displays errors in a consistent component (toast/alert) and prevents duplicate submissions while loading.

file_operations.description: Create a shared alert component for displaying validation, authorization, and unexpected errors consistently across pages.
Centralize mapping of thrown errors into user-friendly English messages (including authorization failures) for use by all pages and hooks.
Add reusable validation helpers for numeric ranges, required fields, and file type/size checks used across all module forms.
Wire shared validation + AppAlert; disable submit while loading to prevent duplicate submissions.
Wire shared validation + AppAlert; disable submit while loading to prevent duplicate submissions; show clear errors for missing/invalid image.
Wire shared validation + AppAlert; disable submit while loading to prevent duplicate submissions.

requirements.summary: Add production-ready documentation and brief explanatory comments for frontend data flow and assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: README includes: prerequisites, install steps, how to run locally, how to deploy locally with dfx, and how to use each module UI.
Documentation explains platform constraints vs the originally requested Python/ML stack and what is implemented instead.
Key logic sections (backend prediction/recommendation logic and frontend API calls) include brief explanatory comments.

file_operations.description: Write frontend-focused run instructions and module usage/testing notes, including Internet Identity behavior and how UI maps to backend capabilities.
Add brief comments explaining request/response flow, validation assumptions, and how results are handled in the UI.
Add brief comments explaining file-to-bytes conversion and ExternalBlob usage for image submission. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add brief comments explaining request/response flow and UI assumptions.

requirements.summary: Include small in-repo sample datasets/artifacts as static assets and load them locally in the frontend.
acceptanceCriteria: Repo includes at least one small sample dataset file for crop yield visualization and one disease label→treatment mapping file.
Frontend loads these assets without requiring any external network calls.

file_operations.description: Ensure the sample crop yield dataset is present and suitable for local visualization context (small demo-ready payload).
Ensure the disease mapping file is present and loaded locally for UI hints/treatments (small demo-ready payload).
Implement a loader that reads frontend/public/assets/data/disease-label-treatment-map.json and exposes mappings for display without external calls.

requirements.summary: Implement authenticated user History views (per module or centralized) with timestamps, key outputs, and clear-history action that updates UI immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can view a list of past results for each module including timestamp and output summary.
Users can clear their history; backend deletes the stored entries for that principal.
UI updates immediately after clearing (refetch or optimistic update).

file_operations.description: Create a reusable History section component that renders lists with timestamps and output summaries and supports a clear-history action (gated behind authentication).
Add a React Query mutation hook for actor.clearHistory and invalidate/refetch history queries on success for immediate UI updates.
Embed a Crop Yield history panel (authenticated only) that lists past results and supports clearing history.
Embed a Disease Detection history panel (authenticated only) that lists past results and supports clearing history.
Embed an Irrigation history panel (authenticated only) that lists past results and supports clearing history.
Ensure charts reflect cleared history immediately by depending on the shared history queries invalidated after clearHistory.
